rows.label: bf11260100_0010
rows.name:
Yes. Since Metsu sank their homeland, many units
seem to have lost their chain of command.

rows.label: bf11260100_0020
rows.name:
We're disarming them as best we can, but
what happened to that village...

rows.label: bf11260100_0030
rows.name:
We've seen firsthand how
bad it is everywhere.

rows.label: bf11260100_0040
rows.name:
Every faction seems to have forgotten
its original purpose and keeps fighting.

rows.label: bf11260100_0050
rows.name:
I suppose that shows how little breathing room
the world has left.

rows.label: bf11260100_0070
rows.name:
By the way, how is the
situation in Iira?

rows.label: bf11260100_0080
rows.name:
Under the wise rule of His Majesty the King,
the people are enjoying a life of peace...

rows.label: bf11260100_0100
rows.name:
So in reality, it's the
same everywhere...

rows.label: bf11260100_0110
rows.name:
Metsu's destruction has started
to reach Iiran territory.

rows.label: bf11260100_0120
rows.name: If we could, we'd send reinforcements too, but...

rows.label: bf11260100_0140
rows.name: That's why Acedia gave her to us, after all.
